name: 85194 · Casa Grande, AZ
findings: ZIP 85194 (Casa Grande) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85194 (Casa Grande) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85194 (Casa Grande) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
